question: In the sewage sludge co-incineration run with the highest incineration temperature, what gas velocity and P/Fe/Na ratio were used?
rendered:
<document title="Co-Incineration of Real Municipal Sewage Sludge in a Fluidized Bed: Effects of the Coexistence of P, Fe, and Na on Agglomeration and Heavy Metal Emissions">

=== page 3 ===
- Figure 1 illustrates the defluidization time of the feedstock containing P, Fe, and Na (0.4:3:1) under varying operating temperatures, and Table S1 presents the raw defluidization time data.
- Notably, the minimum defluidization time was recorded at 900 °C, suggesting accelerated agglomeration at higher temperatures.
